<thought>Using the high‑resolution ESI‑MS data, the most plausible exact mass matches the protonated ion [M+H]+ of the neutral formula C₈H₁₄NO. The calculated m/z for [M+H]+ is 141.1148, within ~4 ppm of the observed 141.1154, and the isotopic pattern (≈9 % M+1) is consistent with eight carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H14NO</final_answer>
